description:
We are looking to add GIS capabilities to our team, we are looking for two positions.

 
 experienced GIS Applications Developer 

 experienced GIS Analyst our Mapjects applications team.

 
 

 You can help develop desktop, web, and mobile applications utilizing the latest spatial technologies available (ESRI, KML, Open GIS), such as 

 
 Spatial (map) based desktop

 Spatial web applications

 Spatial integration with business applications

 Spatial iOS applications for government entities

 Single Page GIS-based web applications utilizing various Javascript frameworks

 
 Our Technology stack, that we use  build client applications include:

 
 ESRI ArcGIS 10.x Server

 ESRI ArcGIS Online

 ESRI ArcEngine/Desktop

 Microsoft MVC 4

 Java, and or C#.NET 4.5

 Javascript (including various frameworks and libraries)

 Microsoft SQL Server 2008/12, Oracle 11g, MySql

 PostgreSQL

 
 

 We are looking to hire developers who have a desire and aptitude for learning new technologies as they become available as well as identifying and implementing creative ways to use spatial data for business applications. If you are interested in utilizing spatial technologies, building applications with a great team, and learning new technologies, we have a position for you.

 ESRI,

 Java, J2EE

 

 Green Card Holder or US Citizens

 DC metro area

 ensure it has your contact information, and phone number to reach you.
